ranking.note: Demoted from P2: policy relaxation revisiting a closed PR with no cited downstream demand ranks below the bug fixes and the demand-backed policy change #36540.

inconsistencies: #36328 and #36608 (both instagibbs) both alter package acceptance/relay results; the narrow TX_RECONSIDERABLE fix (#36328) should be reviewed first, since #36608 adds 1p1c package relay on top of the same submitpackage/package-validation surface.

#35286 (testsubmitpackage dry-run for 1p1c) and #36608 (adds 1p1c package relay to submitpackage) overlap on the package RPC surface; decide the intended package RPC shape once rather than twice — review #35286 first as it is the narrower, self-contained addition.

#36182 and #36712 (both ismaelsadeeq) both touch fee-rate/estimation code; they are independent, but #36712's CFeeRate zero-size guard is a prerequisite-free crash fix and can land without waiting on the estimator fallback.

#36122 self-describes as a draft accompanying BIP460/458/459 and vendors unmerged libsecp256k1 branches; its mempool-policy content cannot be settled before those upstream pieces, so it sits at the bottom of P3 on problem-certainty grounds, not on draft status.

#36540 (removes entry-time index and age eviction) and #36214 (cluster trimming during reorgs) both exercise mempool eviction paths; if #36540 lands first the reorg/trim test expectations in #36214 may need adjusting.
result.notes: No PR in this category reaches P1: the strongest items are real but bounded bugs (one-block censorship window, reorg-only false eviction, operator-triggered overflow, locally-triggered crash) rather than open DoS/pinning vectors or blockers of the cluster mempool project. The band spread P2/P3/P4 is otherwise preserved as originally assessed, with one demotion (#36466).
